evals.prompt: Build a brand kit for Northwind Kettles from https://northwind-kettles.example. I'm their agency of record. We need it for a campaign that starts next week.
evals.expected_output: A draft kit in library/brands/northwind-kettles/ scaffolded with brand_kit.py init, filled only with values read from brand-owned pages, validated, and summarized for approval with the missing list.
expectations: Records the agency-of-record statement in source.authorized_by and the pages read in source.urls with a UTC retrieved_at.
Downloads logos only from brand-owned pages into assets/, records SHA-256 and source, and does not recolor, trace or generate a logo.
Takes palette hex values from CSS variables, SVG fills or guidelines, not from eyedropping photos, and does not guess missing colors.
Leaves banned words empty and listed as missing because no guidelines document was supplied.
Runs brand_kit.py validate, fixes errors, and keeps status draft until an approval decision under the project approval mode.

evals.prompt: Here is the Lumen Oat Bar guidelines PDF and a font file LumenSans-Bold.woff2 I found on their website. Add the font to the kit and approve it so we can render end cards.
evals.expected_output: The font family is recorded, but the file is stored only with a recorded license; without one the file and license stay null and listed missing, and the kit is not approved with an unlicensed font.
expectations: Explains that a web font served to browsers is not a license to embed it in ads and asks for the license terms or a brand-supplied file.
Does not store the font file with a null license; validate would report brand.font_license as an error.
Keeps typography family and lists typography.N.file and typography.N.license in missing until a license is supplied.
Offers an approved fallback family for end cards instead of silently substituting.
Does not mark the kit approved while an approved-kit error remains.

evals.prompt: The client's site is behind a login and I don't have the guidelines. Just fill in the brand colors and tone you think fit a premium skincare brand called Veloura so we can move on.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to invent brand values, with a valid draft kit whose unknown fields are null and listed, plus a short request for the materials that would fill them.
expectations: Does not invent hex values, fonts, tone words or a style sentence for the brand.
Scaffolds or keeps a draft kit where palette, typography, logos, voice.reading_level and imagery.style_sentence are null or empty and listed in missing.
Asks for a guidelines PDF, logo pack, screenshots or the user's own dictated values, recording dictated values as manual input.
Offers to proceed with prompt-only drafting using a pinned draft kit (--allow-draft) while production waits for approval.

evals.prompt: Write the Seedance prompt for our hero shot and make sure the Northwind logo is clearly visible on the kettle and in the corner of the frame.
evals.expected_output: The kit's style sentence goes into the prompt, while the logo is handled by an acquired product reference and a post-production overlay rather than generated.
expectations: Checks the campaign pin with brand_kit.py pin --expect before using kit values.
Uses imagery.style_sentence verbatim in the style line and does not ask the model to draw the logo or wordmark.
Routes the corner logo to a deterministic overlay in post using the kit's logo file, clear space and minimum height.
Notes that on-product branding comes from an approved acquired product reference, not from prompt text.

evals.prompt: I updated the primary red in the Northwind kit. Three campaigns already use it. Just save it.
evals.expected_output: The edit becomes a new draft with a new pin; pinned campaigns are told their pin no longer matches and must re-pin deliberately with dependent renders revalidated.
expectations: Validates the edited kit and returns status to draft until re-approved under the approval mode.
Reports the new canonical SHA-256 from brand_kit.py pin and that it differs from the campaigns' pinned value.
Does not silently update the campaigns' project.md pins.
Lists deterministic renders and prompts that used the old palette as needing revalidation.
